utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — has the carpool schedule changed at all?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not as far as I know. I’m still planning on the usual pickup time unless someone lets me know otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, I’ll keep the usual pickup time then. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time are we doing the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s do 7:30 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — I just want to double-check the timing and pickup order first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the pickup time and who’s first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m here and ready to help. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re leaving at 7:30, and I’ve got the snack bag and the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I’ll be ready by 7:30 then. Thanks for grabbing the snacks and sheet, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and which kids are riding? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, I’m blanking on the details right now. I need to check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—just send me the pickup time and the kids’ names when you check, and I’ll confirm after that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — is there still room in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, there’s still room — hop in!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’m in!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — happy to help with the carpool. What time are we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking around 7:30, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me — I can be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the pickup spots and times—just tell me where everyone’s starting from.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, Leo — what’s up with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet — I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, I’m hearing the carpool’s still on, but I should check who’s driving this week. Want me to ask around and text you back?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please—that’d be great. Text me once you find out who’s driving this week!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and text you as soon as I know who’s driving this week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s driving the carpool this week?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I’m still waiting to hear back, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — can you text me once it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help with the carpool—I'll repeat the plan to everyone once we settle the details. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m hearing 7:30 works for the carpool, but I’d love to confirm the final time with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat 7:30 to everyone and make sure we confirm it with the group.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the carpool list organized now. Do you want to be on the morning or afternoon route?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s meeting at the community center next Thursday, and we’re reading "The Light Between Oceans."

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, thanks — I think you may be mixing that with the book club. For the carpool, do you prefer the morning route or the afternoon route?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard any new carpool updates yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please let me know as soon as you hear anything, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late — are we still on for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still on for the carpool — I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m headed out now — I’ll be there in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli—do you want to figure out the carpool for this week?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and keep you posted as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it down, but I still need the final pickup spots and times before I can confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send the final pickup spots and times over soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate the carpool—what time and days are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’d like to confirm the exact days first—are we talking weekdays only, and what pickup time works best?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, weekdays only works for me. I’m flexible on pickup time, but 8:00 a.m. seems like a good target.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — carpool. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still checking the schedule, but I think we may need to shift pickup by ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ten minutes sounds fine — just let me know when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, any update on the carpool yet? I can help shuffle things if needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’m checking on it now. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — appreciate it. Just give me a shout when you hear back, and I can help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what do you need for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you confirm the pickup time and whether we’re taking my car or yours?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can pick you up at 7:30, and let’s take my car this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do it, but I need the exact pickup time and address first so I can plan the route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll send you the pickup time and address.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks — send them over when you have them and I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together the carpool now—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a spot. I’ll bring my usual share of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you down. Thanks for bringing supplies—I'll keep you posted on the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what time does Oren need the carpool to pick him up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think around 8:15 would be best. Sorry, I always mix up the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries — 8:15 works for me. I’ll plan for that pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m glad we’re sorting out the carpool. What days and times work best for you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still getting the hang of everyone’s schedule, but weekday mornings usually work best for me. If you have a rough plan, I can try to fit in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — weekday mornings it is. I’ll draft a rough carpool plan and send it over for you to check.
